name: Nestbox
description: Boxes inside boxes: an inner grid of frames, each with its middle cut out.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @doodle(@grid: 3 / 100%; background: #0000; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 7px #000;); mask: @doodle(@grid: 3 / 100%; background: #0000; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 7px #000;); -webkit-mask-size: 100% 100%; mask-size: 100% 100%; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
